Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Bulls.

Bottom line: the Spurs win 88 times in 100, by about 15; most games like this end between 214 and 263 total points.

analyst.text: San Antonio bring the league's longest winning streak (nine) to Chicago, fresh off Victor Wembanyama's 40-point, nine-block night in Phoenix. There is a homecoming subplot: Billy Donovan, Chicago's coach for six seasons until last spring, returns as a Spurs assistant. Chicago have lost seven straight and have allowed 124 or more in nine in a row. The Spurs' momentum is the dominant mental factor; the only counterweight is the usual risk of a big favourite relaxing.
